name: io.github.avi-aggarwal14/dare-mcp-server
title: Dare
description: Generate AI video and images on Dare (Seedance, Veo, Kling, Hailuo), billed to your own Dare credits

environmentVariables.name: DARE_CLIENT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your Dare __client cookie from clerk.trydare.com. Optional if `npx dare-mcp-server setup` already saved it. Grants full access to your Dare account.

environmentVariables.name: DARE_MAX_CREDITS_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Refuse any single generation estimated above this many credits.

environmentVariables.name: DARE_UPLOAD_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated directories dare_upload_media may read local files from. Empty means local file reads are refused.
